summary.prose: Building s7 means giving the relationship row's empty value a meaning: a codec for one evidence byte, the two edge writers and the pending rows carrying it, every place that decides a relationship stamping it ('extracted' in the file's own resolution and the manifest step, 'inferred' in the cross-file and endpoint passes), and the reads that return relationships handing it back, up to the daemon's requests and the analyzer's caller, inheritance and import lookups. No stored form or schema version changes; rows written before read 'unknown'.

tasks.title: Add the five evidence values, RelationRead, Relation.evidence and the byte codec
tasks.summary: RelationEvidence widens to 'unknown' | 'extracted' | 'inferred' | 'chosen' | 'model' and RelationRead is exported (src/shared/types.ts); the writers' Relation gains an optional evidence; src/db/graph/codec.ts gets the encoding (empty/0x00 unknown, 0x01-0x04) and decoding (empty, 0x00 and any unrecognised byte read 'unknown'); an evidence string with no byte encodes empty and is reported so the caller can log it.
acceptanceChecks: the five values and RelationRead are exported and typecheck
every value round-trips through the codec; empty, 0x00 and 0xFF decode to 'unknown'
an invalid string encodes to the empty value

tests.name: evidence codec round-trip and unknown decoding

tasks.title: Write the evidence byte at both edge writers and carry it through pending
tasks.summary: upsertResolvedRelationsInTxn writes the relation's byte to both out_edge and in_edge; promoteResolvedBatch takes items[].evidence, else the pending row's meta.evidence, else empty, and promoteToResolved passes it through; a relationship kept awaiting stores its evidence in the row's meta.evidence; returnEdgeToPendingInTxn decodes the edge's byte into the awaiting row it writes; an invalid evidence value is stored empty and logged at warn, never refused.
acceptanceChecks: both rows of every written edge hold the same byte
a resolved relationship kept awaiting carries meta.evidence and its later promotion without an explicit evidence stores that value
an edge returned to pending and promoted again keeps its evidence
an invalid evidence value stores the edge with an empty value and a warn log; the relationship is not refused
rewriting an existing edge with a different evidence leaves the new byte on both rows

tasks.title: Stamp 'extracted' at the per-file decisions and carry it through the file commit
tasks.summary: resolveRelations marks every relation it returns resolved (parser-resolved, same-file CALLS, relative IMPORTS to a file) 'extracted'; the manifest step's DEPENDS_ON is written 'extracted'; writeOfRelation sets RelationWrite.evidence from the relation and relationOfWrite carries it to the commit's writers instead of dropping it.
acceptanceChecks: a same-file call indexed through the file commit is stored 'extracted'
a relative import awaiting its not-yet-stored file is stored 'extracted' when the file arrives (Pass 0)
the repository's DEPENDS_ON edges are 'extracted'
no relation resolveRelations returns as resolved lacks evidence

tests.name: resolveRelations evidence 'extracted' through the file commit

tasks.title: Stamp 'inferred' in the cross-file and endpoint passes; Pass 0 keeps the carried value
tasks.summary: Pass 1 (IMPORTS rewire), Pass 1b (re-exports) and Pass 2 (name resolution) pass 'inferred'; both endpoint passes pass 'inferred'; Pass 0 passes none so the row's carried evidence is stored; an ambiguous call stays pending with its candidates and no edge.
acceptanceChecks: a call resolved across files is stored 'inferred' (ac1)
a call matching several candidates stays pending classed 'ambiguous' with its candidates and no edge; no stored edge decodes to 'chosen' (ac2)
external-service and messaging edges are 'inferred'
Pass 0 restores an awaiting row with its carried evidence, not 'inferred'

tests.name: cross-file passes evidence 'inferred'; Pass 0 keeps the carried value

tasks.title: Return evidence from the single-kind reads and the opt-in neighbour form
tasks.summary: neighborEntities reads each edge row's value, so findCallers/findCallees/findDefinedIn/findImports return each entity with its relationship's evidence; outNeighbors/inNeighbors gain the withEvidence form returning one row per stored relationship with kind and evidence; the id-only form and every traversal are unchanged.
acceptanceChecks: findCallers/findCallees return evidence per entity
edges written with an empty value (a pre-change store) read 'unknown' with no migration and SCHEMA_VERSION unchanged (ac3)
outNeighbors({ withEvidence: true }) returns one row per relationship across kinds; the id-only form still dedupes
bfs/transitiveClosure results are unchanged
existing tests of these reads pass, updated only where they compare the whole entity; the inventory pins of the edited files are refreshed

tasks.title: Carry evidence through the daemon's caller/callee requests and the graph tools
tasks.summary: search.callers, search.callees and each hop of search.callers_nhop return entities with their evidence field; the graph_callers/graph_callees tools include evidence in each short entity; no field is removed or renamed.
acceptanceChecks: search.callers returns each caller with evidence
search.callers_nhop's callers carry evidence at every hop
graph tool results include evidence
existing response fields are unchanged
proved with in-process handler tests, not the seeded-daemon tests; the inventory pins are refreshed

tasks.title: Mark evidence in the analyzer's caller, inheritance and import lookups
tasks.summary: usage.example's hits carry their relationship's evidence and its result states how many listed callers are inferred or chosen and how many of unknown origin; class-hierarchy and import-graph read through the withEvidence neighbour form and carry evidence on each parent/child and importer/importee.
acceptanceChecks: a usage.example over extracted, inferred and unknown callers lists each with its evidence and states the counts (ac4)
an all-unknown result says the origin is unknown instead of implying it was read from the source
class-hierarchy and import-graph items carry evidence

tasks.title: Ship and smoke on the installed daemon
tasks.summary: Full sweep once, update the installed daemon, and on this repository check that after a file is re-indexed its callers through search.callers carry 'extracted' (same file) and 'inferred' (across files), and that a relationship not rewritten since the update reads 'unknown'.
acceptanceChecks: full sweep shows no failure caused by this Story
on the installed daemon: a re-indexed file's same-file and cross-file callers read 'extracted' and 'inferred'; an untouched relationship reads 'unknown' (recorded)

tests.name: installed daemon: evidence after re-index; untouched relationship 'unknown'
